name: Centro / Plaza Mayor
description: The historic center around the Plaza Mayor is where most of the city's restaurants, shops, banks, and the best cafe wifi options cluster. It is walkable, always busy with mototaxi traffic, and puts you within easy reach of everything, though the noise and bustle run nonstop from morning into the evening.
bestFor: first-time visitors and short stays who want everything within walking distance
pros: most walkable area with shops and restaurants nearby
best concentration of cafes and banks
easy to find mototaxis and colectivos

name: Morales
tagline: A calmer riverside district next door
description: Morales is a separate district bordering central Tarapoto, quieter than the centro but only a short mototaxi ride away. It sits closer to the Cumbaza river and has a more residential, laid-back feel with local eateries and green spaces, making it popular with longer-term residents who still want easy access to the city center.
bestFor: longer stays looking for a calmer residential base near the river
pros: closer to the Cumbaza river and green spaces
still a short ride to downtown amenities
cons: less walkable to restaurants and shops

name: La Banda de Shilcayo
tagline: Green edge of the city toward the waterfalls
description: On the eastern edge of Tarapoto toward the Cordillera Escalera and Ahuashiyacu waterfall road, La Banda de Shilcayo feels more spread out and jungle-adjacent, with newer housing developments and easy access to nature reserves. It suits people who want proximity to hiking and waterfalls over central nightlife.
bestFor: nature lovers wanting quick access to hikes and waterfalls
pros: closest area to the Cordillera Escalera reserve and trailheads
greener, more spacious feel than downtown
good for hikers and outdoor-focused routines
cons: further from central restaurants and services
relies more heavily on mototaxis to get around

name: Sauce (Laguna Azul)
tagline: Lakeside retreat about an hour from Tarapoto
description: Sauce is a small lakeside town around an hour's drive from Tarapoto, built around the striking turquoise waters of the Blue Lagoon (Laguna Azul). It works as a peaceful weekend base or slower alternative for those who want lake views, kayaking, and a quieter pace, trading city convenience for scenery and calm.
bestFor: a quiet lakeside retreat or weekend escape from city life
pros: much quieter and slower than Tarapoto
good for kayaking, swimming, and lakeside relaxation
cons: about an hour from Tarapoto's amenities and airport
very limited wifi and services compared to the city
